tool: KI-696 = CHEMBL3819587 (Davies lead; Tran 9; Wu C7)
mechanism_source: 27031670 abstract [CH]; 31411465 (Tran) Table 1 and Discussion; X-ray complex 5FNU quoted in Tran
measured_in: ITC Kd 1.3 nM [CH]; SPR Kd 0.0014 uM and FP Ki about 0.001 uM (Tran, via IT45 reader); cells: NHBE, BEAS2B, COPD HBEC (EC50 12-36 nM [CH]); LUHMES at 40 uM (enantiomer 2); primary rat microglia and BV2 at 0.5-1 uM
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Tran: selectivity for the Kelch domain 'demonstrated for compounds 7 and 9' (Tran numbering) in the literature; [CH]: 46 off-target panel assays labelled 'Not active' (receptors, enzymes, channels, transporters), with IC50 values of 10 uM for PDE3A, 4 uM for BSEP and 2.5 uM for OATP1B1; unknown: NRF2-independent actions in neurons, brain exposure, whether acid permeability limits neurons (Tran raises acid permeability concern for the class)
specific_limit: Costa: 40 uM needed in LUHMES and knockdown inadequate; Wu: binding not measured in the paper; Davies knockdown values only [CH]
role_supported: probe (conditional: with a verified NRF2-loss arm and a KEAP1-loss occlusion arm in the same cell)

measured_in: LUHMES 40 uM: Ki 696-2 protective, Ki 696-1 not
selectivity_known_and_unknown: Kelch binding of each enantiomer not measured in the document; assignment to the ChEMBL structure not given
specific_limit: Do not use as a binding-null control without a binding measurement

mechanism_source: IT45 reader [AB]/[CH] for thiol reactivity; not re-read
measured_in: NHBE 100 nM with NRF2 siRNA [CH]; LUHMES: extremely neurotoxic above nanomolar, withdrawn (Costa)
selectivity_known_and_unknown: pleiotropic (reacts with many proteins; Wu Discussion cites more than 500 molecules for CDDO analogs, as a citation)
specific_limit: neurotoxic in LUHMES at nanomolar-to-micromolar; acid versus methyl ester are different structures
role_supported: comparator (conditional on a non-toxic exposure window; not in LUHMES as tested)

mechanism_source: 21354971 abstract (MMF modifies KEAP1 Cys151); 38116420 per IT45 reader
measured_in: Nrf2-deficient EAE mice (abstract); N9 microglia MMF 1 uM (Parodi); neurons and astrocytes protein modification (abstract)
selectivity_known_and_unknown: HCAR2 agonism by MMF (Parodi: N9 line, antibody blockade); modification of 24 other proteins in neurons/astrocytes (abstract); NF-kB and ERK route stated by 38116420 per IT45 reader
specific_limit: A fumarate effect on a single NRF2 target gene (Hmox1) is also moved through HCAR2 in microglia
role_supported: comparator (not a pure NRF2 probe: both NRF2-dependent and independent routes documented)

measured_in: primary cortical cultures from mice; knock-out and DN-Nrf2 arms (tBHQ)
selectivity_known_and_unknown: tBHQ response lost in knock-out; sulforaphane in the knock-out arm not stated in the abstract
specific_limit: abstract only; full text unreachable; adenoviral arm selective for astrocytes
role_supported: comparator (tBHQ, with a compartment caveat); sulforaphane unqualified here

class: NRF2 inhibitor (reported to bind the NRF2 CNC-bZip/Neh1 region)
mechanism_source: 27552339 (pull-down with biotin analog; FP IC50 1.9 uM on NRF2-MAFG-ARE DNA)
measured_in: A549, H460 isogenic KEAP1 pair, BEAS2B; kinase panel about 170 kinases at 5 uM; used in primary microglia by Wu 2024
selectivity_known_and_unknown: selective growth effect where NRF2 is constitutively high (KEAP1-mutant H460); no kinase hit at 5 uM; unknown: off-target proteins beyond the panel, action in cells with low NRF2 activity, neural cells
specific_limit: no neural use in its source; in Wu its concentration and specificity were not shown; it lowers NRF2 mRNA too
role_supported: unqualified for neural comparison (partly qualified in KEAP1-mutant lung lines); a genetic NRF2-loss arm is the stronger comparator

class: general translation repressor (not an NRF2-selective control)
mechanism_source: IT45 reader [AB] of the Tsuchida abstract: 'repressed global protein synthesis'; not re-reached in this package
selectivity_known_and_unknown: NRF2 depletion is a consequence of global synthesis repression in that source; no selectivity claimed
specific_limit: this package did not reach a halofuginone source; the ML385 paper states the same kind of limit for brusatol (inhibits DNA, RNA and protein synthesis)

class: quassinoid reported as an NRF2 inhibitor
